script_text: Libra, this week the air itself is rearranging your love life. Early week, Venus in your 1st House opposes Neptune in your 7th. Monday and Tuesday blur attraction with projection—don't mistake fantasy for fate. By Wednesday, Mercury in your 3rd sextiles Pluto in your 5th, a midweek turning point that sharpens desire and creative courage. That same Venus sextiles Saturn in your 6th, stabilizing work routines and income if you honor the boring details. Late week, the Sun conjuncts Mercury in your 3rd, then trines Jupiter in your 11th, bringing a paid invitation through friends or networks. Thursday is your power day because Venus in your 1st sextiles Saturn in your 6th. Monday is your hardest day because Venus opposes Neptune in your 7th, tempting you to idealize the wrong person. Protect your airy clarity: write down one boundary before you say yes. Follow for daily updates.
